15350|44b49612.name: Horde Warbringer
15350|44b49612.text: War is upon us, $N.  It's time for every member of the Horde to answer the call and join the fight against the cowardly Alliance.

2229|3114fa62.name: Krusk
2229|3114fa62.text: To think, the place the Warchief was born and raised lies so close.

2388|0d7f0fc2.name: Innkeeper Shay
2388|0d7f0fc2.text: We don't have much in the way of story or history of the Wetlands Excavation Site, but we do know that a mining crew of perilous arrogance attempted to blast a passage into the southern mountains overlooking Dun Morogh. A marshland that was forgotten was in the shadow of a lost titan watcher. Many have been sent in an attempt to discover the fate of the lost miners.

2388|4a0923b3.name: Innkeeper Shay
2388|4a0923b3.text: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?

2388|f331e69a.name: Innkeeper Shay
2388|f331e69a.text: The entrance to Whelgar's Excavation Site can be found in the southern valley of the Wetlands. A cave along the western mountain ridge marks the passage.

2388|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Shay
2388|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

2389|c5ceacbe.name: Zarise
2389|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2391|5dffcf15.name: Serge Hinott
2391|5dffcf15.text: Another interruption. How am I supposed to get any work done like this? Don't answer that; do I look as if I care what you have to say? Why don't you go bother Mr. High-And-Mighty instead?

2410|8b3451aa.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
2410|8b3451aa.text: My studies take me far from the Under City, but to truly learn one must be near to the source of knowledge.

2425|7dca81fc.name: Varimathras
2425|7dca81fc.text:
Do not presume to speak to me as though you are my equal, $c. Sylvanas is my queen, and I will do as she bids.

If you do not show the proper respect, I assure you, we can find a more than suitable place for you in the Nether.

But there is no reason we cannot have words if you wish to aid the Dark Lady...

266484|e94c420f.name: Morbin Lightbane
266484|e94c420f.text:
We paladins must earn our place amongst our Forsaken kin each day, lest we be judged as fanatics like the Scarlet Crusade. The light is not simply a tool of our foes, but a conduit for our righteous fury! It is in our devotion to the Dark Lady and the love of our home that we may channel the light to bring justice to our enemies.

The Banshee Queen keeps a close eye on us. Let her. She will see that our resolve shall never waver. We are Forsaken!

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

517-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
517-progress.text:
Sometimes I get so bored out here in Tarren Mill I like to open up the formaldehyde jar and let the lovely aroma waft through the air.  Makes Umpi a little nervous though.

So were you able to get a keg from the Dwarves?  I swear if I have to stare at this deadly elixir without using it on someone for another day I am going to scream.
517-progress.title: Elixir of Agony

524-progress.name: Dusty Rug
524-progress.text: A musty smell emanates from the rug.
524-progress.title: Elixir of Agony

547-progress.name: Deathguard Humbert
547-progress.text: Were you able to retrieve my sword, $N?  High Executor Darthalia will hang me from the rafters if she discovers my folly.
547-progress.title: Humbert's Sword

550-progress.name: Varimathras
550-progress.text: What brings a $c all the way to the Undercity from the battlefield?
550-progress.title: Battle of Hillsbrad
